edgePairing.title: Pair an Edge device
edgePairing.description: Start pairing on your Edge device, then enter the code it displays. Only confirm a device you recognize.
edgePairing.name: Device name
edgePairing.textOnly: OpenAI SDK · multi-turn text conversation · no tool execution
edgePairing.verify: Check that the device name, runtime and workspace match your Edge device before confirming.
edgePairing.confirmed: Pairing confirmed. Keep the Edge running to finish connecting; it becomes selectable after a healthy check-in.
edgePairing.alreadyConfirmed: This request has already been confirmed. Continue on the Edge device.
edgePairing.expired: This code has expired. Start pairing again on the Edge device, then enter the new code.
edgePairing.lookupFailed: Could not review this code. It may be invalid, expired or already used. Check your connection and the code on your Edge device.
edgePairing.confirmFailed: Pairing could not be confirmed. Review the code again; it may have expired or already been confirmed.
edgePairing.profileHint: In Agents, create a profile with the openai-sdk runtime and your model name. Select that profile and the healthy paired device in a conversation. The workspace is fixed on the Edge.
edgePairing.revokeWarning: Revoke this device's access to your Hub tasks? It will need to pair again. This does not stop a process already running on the device.
edgePairing.revoked: Device access revoked. Pair it again to reconnect.
edgePairing.revokeFailed: Could not revoke device access. Check your connection and retry.
edgePairing.runtimeMismatch: This paired Edge requires an openai-sdk agent profile. Select a matching profile before sending.
edgePairing.modelRequired: Set an explicit model name in the openai-sdk agent profile before saving or sending.
edgePairing.textAttachmentsUnsupported: This paired Edge supports text conversations only. Remove attachments before sending.
